pages.title: Moonward
pages.summary: A moth spirit climbs out of a burned forest toward the moon.
pages.body:
A quiet, melancholy action-platformer. You are the [[wanderer]], a small moth spirit woken in the ashes of a forest that burned long ago. The only light left is the moon, hanging far above the smoke. The game is one long ascent: from the ember-lit ground, up through scorched trunks, to the open sky.

## Tone
Hushed, soft, and elegiac. Ash drifts like snow, embers glow like dim stars, and the music is sparse. Danger is real but the world is more sad than cruel.

## Themes
- Grief and renewal: the forest is dead, but things still grow in it.
- Light as a guide: the moon pulls the player upward, and fire is both the cause of ruin and a source of warmth.
- Smallness: a tiny creature crossing a huge, ruined world.

## Structure
Three areas stacked vertically: [[cinder_floor]], [[charred_canopy]] and [[moonlit_crown]]. Enemies are the forest's leftover creatures, such as the [[crawler]] and the [[charger]].

## Ending
At the crown the Wanderer reaches the moon's light. It does not defeat the fire. It carries a spark of the moon back down, so the forest can begin to regrow.

fields.setting: a burned forest beneath the moon

pages.title: Wanderer
pages.summary: A small moth spirit climbing the burned forest toward the moon.
pages.body:
The Wanderer woke in the ash with no name and one pull: toward the pale light overhead. It is fragile and quick, and it learns to move through the ruin as it rises.

It was once a moth that drew close to the fire and was lost. Now it is a spirit of that memory, and it climbs to find the cool light it should have followed. It never speaks. Its wings glow faintly and brighten near embers and moonlight.

See [[overview]] for the journey. The Wanderer begins in [[cinder_floor]] and ends in [[moonlit_crown]].

fields.appearance: small pale moth with dusty, softly glowing wings

pages.title: Crawler
pages.summary: A slow ash beetle that patrols the ground and trunks.
pages.body:
Crawlers are beetle-like creatures with scorched shells. They plod along floors, walls and branches in simple patrols and turn at ledges. They are not malicious. They are survivors who keep walking the paths they knew before the fire.

- Behavior: walks a set route and damages on contact.
- Found mostly in [[cinder_floor]] and also in [[charred_canopy]].
- Teaches the player to time jumps and spacing before the faster [[charger]].

fields.appearance: charcoal-black beetle with glowing ember cracks in its shell

pages.title: Charger
pages.summary: A skittish boar-like husk that rushes at the player on sight.
pages.body:
Chargers are the remains of forest beasts, bound to the ash. They stand still until the [[wanderer]] enters their line of sight, then dash straight ahead and stop dazed when they hit a wall. That pause is the player's chance to slip past.

- Behavior: idles, telegraphs with a snort of embers, then rushes in a straight line.
- Found in the open stretches of [[charred_canopy]] and the paths of [[moonlit_crown]].
- A step up in pressure from the [[crawler]].

fields.appearance: hunched, antlered husk of ash with ember eyes

pages.title: Cinder Floor
pages.summary: The ash-buried forest floor where the Wanderer wakes.
pages.body:
A dim, low-ceilinged land of ash drifts, fallen logs and smoldering roots. Embers pulse in the dark like slow heartbeats. Far above, the moon shows as a thin pale hole in the smoke.

- Start of the game. Gentle, with open space for learning basic movement.
- Enemies: [[crawler]].
- Leads upward via the standing trunks to [[charred_canopy]].

fields.appearance: grey ash dunes, black roots, orange glowing cracks

pages.title: Charred Canopy
pages.summary: A tangle of blackened trunks and bridges of branches high above the ash.
pages.body:
Towering burned trunks, skeletal branches and wind-torn hanging bark. Smoke thins here and shafts of moonlight cut through. Gaps between trunks demand more skillful movement, and the vertical climbing is the core of this region.

- Enemies: [[crawler]] and [[charger]].
- Below it is [[cinder_floor]]. Above it is [[moonlit_crown]].

fields.appearance: black trunks, pale light shafts, drifting sparks

pages.title: Moonlit Crown
pages.summary: The summit above the smoke, where the moon is finally close.
pages.body:
The tallest tree's crown breaks through the smoke into a clear night. Silver light falls on pale, living leaves, the first green in the whole game. The air is still and cold.

- Final area and the end of the journey. Here the [[wanderer]] reaches the moon's light.
- Enemies: [[charger]] guards the last paths.
- Reached from [[charred_canopy]].

fields.appearance: silver light, pale green leaves, open starry sky

pages.title: Ember Roots
pages.summary: A network of burned-out root tunnels beneath the ash, still smouldering.
pages.body:
Below the ash dunes of [[cinder_floor]] the old roots run deep, hollow and glowing. Embers pulse in the walls like slow heartbeats.

Enemies: [[crawler]]. A huge, ancient crawler guards a dim shrine here, and the Wanderer takes the double jump from it.

fields.appearance: hollow roots like cave tunnels, glowing coals, falling ash
fields.role: first ability area; boss guards double jump

pages.title: Smoke Veil
pages.summary: A band of thick drifting smoke between the canopy and the crown.
pages.body:
Above [[charred_canopy]] the smoke gathers into a ceiling no climber can pass on foot. Updrafts carry the Wanderer through long empty gaps.

Enemies: [[charger]] and [[crawler]]. A quiet shrine here teaches the glide, which is needed to cross to [[moonlit_crown]] with the lantern's spark.

fields.appearance: grey banks of smoke, hanging cinders, faint moonlight overhead
fields.role: late area; glide shrine and the way to the crown

items.name: Moon Lantern
items.description: It opens the way to Moonlit Crown.

modals.title: You got Double Jump
modals.body:
Jump again in mid-air.

It opens the way to Charred Canopy.

modals.title: You got Wall Cling
modals.body:
Slide down walls you press against, and jump off them. Climbs a single wall by jumping off and steering back.

It opens the way to Smoke Veil.

modals.title: You got Ashwing Glide
modals.body:
Hold jump while falling to fall slowly.

It opens the way to Moonlit Crown.

modals.title: You got Moon Lantern
modals.body: It opens the way to Moonlit Crown.

modals.title: The End
modals.body:
The summit above the smoke, where the moon is finally close.

Thanks for playing Untitled Game.

rooms.name: Ashen Landing
rooms.notes: Start. A wide, quiet ash plain with a dying ember glow; teaches walking and jumping.

rooms.name: Cinder Flats
rooms.notes: Scorched ground with low ledges and the first crawlers.

rooms.name: Kindling Hollow
rooms.notes: Sheltered hollow with a save point. A suspicious dead-end wall shaft hints at a place reachable only by clinging to walls.

rooms.name: Charred Stair
rooms.notes: Broken stair of burnt trunks; a high gap above leads toward the canopy and needs a double jump.

rooms.name: Root Gate
rooms.notes: Short passage where the ground cracks open toward the roots below.

rooms.name: Root Mouth
rooms.notes: Descent into glowing roots; sloping ground.

rooms.name: Tangled Tunnel
rooms.notes: Low winding tunnel of glowing roots.

rooms.name: Ember Cistern
rooms.notes: Calm chamber with a save point before the guardian. Embers drift in pools.

rooms.name: Smoldering Warren
rooms.notes: Spiked, root-choked warren with crawlers.

rooms.name: Heart of the Roots
rooms.notes: Round arena around a great burning root. The giant crawler guardian drops Double Jump.

rooms.name: Burnt Understory
rooms.notes: Entry beneath blackened branches, reached by a double jump.

rooms.name: Branchwalk
rooms.notes: Long horizontal run along charred boughs.

rooms.name: Hollow Trunk
rooms.notes: Vertical climb inside a hollowed burnt trunk.

rooms.name: Ember Perch
rooms.notes: Safe perch in the branches with a save point before the guardian.

rooms.name: Cinder Bridge
rooms.notes: Fragile rope-and-bough bridge over a drop.

rooms.name: Crown of Cinders
rooms.notes: Open canopy arena. The charger guardian gives Wall Cling.

rooms.name: Veil Threshold
rooms.notes: Sheer wall faces where smoke begins to thicken; reached by wall cling.

rooms.name: Drifting Haze
rooms.notes: Wide smoke-choked hall with scattered platforms.

rooms.name: Ashwing Shrine
rooms.notes: Quiet shrine of ash-grey wings; the Ashwing Glide is found here. Save point.

rooms.name: Gale Chasm
rooms.notes: Deep chasm with updrafts of smoke; hazards below.

rooms.name: Veil's Edge
rooms.notes: Cliff edge looking toward the moonlit crown across a wide gap; the way needs glide and the lantern.

rooms.name: Moonstep
rooms.notes: Silver-lit landing above the smoke.

rooms.name: Pale Terraces
rooms.notes: Terraced moonlit stone with chargers.

rooms.name: Lantern Rest
rooms.notes: Calm moonlit alcove with a last save point.

rooms.name: Spire Ascent
rooms.notes: Tall climb up the crown spire.

rooms.name: The Moonlit Crown
rooms.notes: Open summit under the moon; the ending.

rooms.name: Moon Lantern Niche
rooms.notes: Hidden niche high in a wall shaft; a pale lantern rests here, untouched by ash.

plan.summary:
planned 27 rooms, 30 links — I shaped the seeded draft into a world of 27 rooms, and checkPlan comes back clean. I didn't queue a build.

- **Rooms:** Every room now has a name and a short note. I varied sizes: wide halls and runs of 40–55 columns, tall climbs of 24–36 rows, and short passages. Terrain follows each region's moo
